services.title: Our services
services.lead: We build professional AI systems tailored to your business, not isolated features or generic templates.

diagnostic.title: Personalized diagnosis
diagnostic.body: We look at where customers reach you today and where you lose them: your website, your WhatsApp, your social channels. You leave with a concrete plan of what to automate first and what to expect from each step, whether you hire us or not.

chatbots.title: Chatbots
chatbots.body: A chatbot trained on your business answers pricing, hours and frequently asked questions in seconds, day and night. Someone who asks at 11pm gets an answer at 11pm, not the next morning.

automation.title: Process automation
automation.body: The repetitive work your team does by hand today: booking and confirming appointments, following up with the customer who asked and never came back, and recording every conversation and contact in a single panel. It runs on its own, with nobody having to remember.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.body: A step beyond a chatbot: the agent does not just answer, it acts. It checks your calendar, books the appointment, updates the customer record and hands off to a person when the case calls for it.

websites.title: Professional websites
websites.body: We design and build your full site: home, services, portfolio and a contact form that lands straight in your WhatsApp. Fast, search-ready, and built so a visit ends in a conversation.

integrations.title: Works with what you already use
integrations.lead: No new tools to learn. We connect to what your business already runs on.

one.question: Do I need to be technical to use this?
one.answer: No. We handle everything. You just see the results.

two.question: How long does it take to implement?
two.answer: Between 2 and 6 weeks depending on scope: Agente Esencial is the fastest, Agente Avanzado takes a little longer, and Agente Multicanal is the longest because it connects several channels. We confirm the exact date for your case on the 15-minute call.

three.question: Does this replace my team?
three.answer: No. It frees your team from repetitive tasks so they can focus on what matters most.

four.question: What if I need help after delivery?
four.answer: Every package includes monthly maintenance: from COP $200,000 on Agente Esencial, $450,000 on Agente Avanzado and $900,000 on Agente Multicanal. That covers adjustments, monitoring and ongoing support — not just bug fixes.

five.question: Does it work for my kind of business?
five.answer: We work mostly with aesthetic clinics, real estate agencies, veterinary clinics, dental practices and gyms: businesses that live on replying fast and filling a calendar. If yours depends on handling WhatsApp enquiries and booking appointments, it applies too, even if it is not on that list.

six.question: Does the diagnostic replace the free 15-minute strategy call?
six.answer: No. The free call is for us to get to know each other and see if we're a fit. The diagnostic is a deeper analysis, with a written deliverable, on what to automate and what not to in your specific business.

seven.question: Do I need to hire an AI agent to take the training?
seven.answer: No. It works as a standalone service. Many businesses use it as a first step before deciding whether to automate anything.

eight.question: Can I hire both services together?
eight.answer: Yes. In fact, the diagnostic is usually the natural first step before the training or before any of the three packages.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Numi AI collects, uses and protects the personal data it receives through its contact form.
privacy.intro: Numi AI collects personal data solely through the contact form on this site. This policy explains what data we receive, what we use it for and how you can request its deletion, in compliance with Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012.
privacy.dataIntro: Only the data you type into the form:

data.four: The description of what you need

privacy.useIntro: For two purposes, and no others:

use.one: To contact you in order to schedule and hold the strategy call you requested.
use.two: To assess your case and prepare a proposal suited to your operation.

privacy.sharing: Nobody. We do not sell, transfer or share your data with third parties, and we do not use it for advertising or to build profiles.
privacy.retention: We keep your data for as long as there is an active commercial conversation with you. If you ask us to delete it, we do.
privacy.rightsTitle: Your rights and how to exercise them
privacy.rights: You may ask us at any time to tell you what data of yours we hold, to correct it, or to delete it entirely. We respond within the timeframes set by law.
privacy.rightsContact: For data deletion requests, write to us at
